title: tc-judge-bracket
description:
An LLM judge picking the best of several attempts as a single-elimination bracket – rounds of matches that fill as
verdicts stream in, a comparison of any match with the judge's reason and confidence, and the champion to use.

task.description: What every attempt tried to do – the quiet line under the heading

attempts.description: The attempts, 2 to 16, in seeding order – the first ones get the byes

verdicts.description: The judge's matches so far – one verdict per match – streamed in as they're judged (`matches` is the DOM's)

match.description: The match whose comparison is open – its key, "<round>-<match>" (both from 1) – or null

accepted.description: The id of the attempt in use, once "Use this answer" was chosen

labels.description: Words the page can rename, merged over defaultJudgeBracketLabels

model.description: The model behind it, shown under the name

summary.description: What it answered, in a sentence or two – shown in the comparison and on the champion's card

score.description: A score the judge or a grader gave it, if any

round.description: 1 for the first round, counting up to the final

a.description: The two attempts' ids, in either order

winner.description: The id of the attempt the judge preferred; left out while it's judging
